entities.summary: Cristino Nicolaides was an Argentine military officer who belonged to his country's army. He held power as a member of the Argentine Military Junta from 1982 to 1983. Representing the Argentine Army, he took power after Argentina's defeat in the Falklands War, in the last phase of the Dirty War, waged by the self-styled National Reorganization Process.
